# tgcalls (TelegramMessenger/tgcalls 1c236c09, as pinned by tdesktop v7.3.1) as a static library, built the way
# tdesktop's Telegram/cmake/lib_tgcalls.cmake builds it on Windows: same 53 sources (sources.cmake, generated by
# tools/gen_tgcalls_cmake.py), same defines (lib_tgcalls + cmake_helpers external_webrtc + options_win
# common_options), /EHsc + RTTI, C++20. Plus tgcalls_link_test.exe, which links tgcalls + tg_owt + all deps.
# Differences from tdesktop: /W1 instead of /W4 + its /wd list (clang-cl noise only), BoringSSL instead of OpenSSL 3.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0091 NEW)
project(tgcalls_rt LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(TGCALLS_DIR "D:/tgcalls/tgcalls" CACHE PATH "tgcalls repo root (tdesktop's tgcalls_dir)")
set(TG_OWT_DIR "D:/tgcalls/tg_owt" CACHE PATH "tg_owt source tree (headers)")
set(TG_OWT_LIB "" CACHE FILEPATH "built tg_owt.lib")
set(DEPS_PREFIX "" CACHE PATH "prefix with include/ and lib/ of ffmpeg, opus, vpx, openh264, jpeg, zlib, rnnoise")
set(SSL_DIR "D:/tgcalls/deps/boringssl" CACHE PATH "BoringSSL source tree (include/)")
set(SSL_LIB_DIR "" CACHE PATH "dir with BoringSSL crypto.lib and ssl.lib")
set(BUILTINS_LIB "" CACHE FILEPATH "optional compiler-rt builtins library for the test link")

set(tgcalls_loc ${TGCALLS_DIR}/tgcalls)
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/sources.cmake)

add_library(tgcalls STATIC ${tgcalls_sources})
target_compile_features(tgcalls PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_compile_definitions(tgcalls
PUBLIC
    # lib_tgcalls.cmake
    TGCALLS_USE_STD_OPTIONAL
    WEBRTC_APP_TDESKTOP
    RTC_ENABLE_H265
    RTC_ENABLE_VP9
    # cmake_helpers/external/webrtc (must match tg_owt's build for header ABI)
    WEBRTC_ENABLE_PROTOBUF=0
    WEBRTC_INCLUDE_INTERNAL_AUDIO_DEVICE
    HAVE_SCTP
    WEBRTC_USE_H264
    WEBRTC_USE_BUILTIN_ISAC_FLOAT
    WEBRTC_LIBRARY_IMPL
    WEBRTC_NON_STATIC_TRACE_EVENT_HANDLERS=1
    WEBRTC_HAVE_DCSCTP
    WEBRTC_HAVE_SCTP
    ABSL_ALLOCATOR_NOTHROW=1
    WEBRTC_WIN
    RTC_ENABLE_WIN_WGC
    # cmake_helpers/external/zlib
    ZLIB_WINAPI
    # cmake_helpers/options_win.cmake common_options
    WIN32 WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN _WINDOWS _SCL_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS NOMINMAX NOSERVICE NOMCX NOIME NOSOUND NOCOMM
    NOKANJI NORPC NOPROXYSTUB NOIMAGE NOTAPE UNICODE _UNICODE
)
target_compile_options(tgcalls PUBLIC /permissive- /utf-8 /W1 /EHsc /Zc:__cplusplus /bigobj)
target_include_directories(tgcalls
PUBLIC
    ${TGCALLS_DIR}
PRIVATE
    ${tgcalls_loc}
)
target_include_directories(tgcalls SYSTEM
PUBLIC
    ${TG_OWT_DIR}/src
    ${TG_OWT_DIR}/src/third_party/abseil-cpp
    ${TG_OWT_DIR}/src/third_party/libyuv/include
PRIVATE
    ${DEPS_PREFIX}/include
    ${SSL_DIR}/include
)

if (TG_OWT_LIB)
    add_executable(tgcalls_link_test ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/tgcalls_link_test.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(tgcalls_link_test PRIVATE
        tgcalls
        ${TG_OWT_LIB}
        ${SSL_LIB_DIR}/ssl.lib ${SSL_LIB_DIR}/crypto.lib
        ${DEPS_PREFIX}/lib/avformat.lib ${DEPS_PREFIX}/lib/avcodec.lib ${DEPS_PREFIX}/lib/swresample.lib
        ${DEPS_PREFIX}/lib/swscale.lib ${DEPS_PREFIX}/lib/avutil.lib
        ${DEPS_PREFIX}/lib/opus.lib ${DEPS_PREFIX}/lib/libvpx.a ${DEPS_PREFIX}/lib/openh264.lib
        ${DEPS_PREFIX}/lib/jpeg-static.lib ${DEPS_PREFIX}/lib/rnnoise.lib ${DEPS_PREFIX}/lib/libzs.lib
        ${BUILTINS_LIB}
        # tg_owt's own list + tdesktop's external_webrtc (Secur32) + common_options subset that the code uses
        secur32 d3d11 dxgi dwmapi shcore strmiids winmm ws2_32 iphlpapi crypt32 bcrypt
        ole32 oleaut32 uuid user32 gdi32 advapi32 shell32 shlwapi version avrt
    )
    target_link_options(tgcalls_link_test PRIVATE /INCREMENTAL:NO /OPT:REF /DEBUG /MAP)
endif()
